name: walk_cycle
source: flybody walking-imitation dataset (small), snippet 080, one claw_T2_left PEP->PEP stride
convention: quat [x,y,z,w]; local = rest(MJCF body quat == GLB bone rest) * delta; delta = product of joint rotations about axis_body in MJCF joint order
note: phase 0 = T2_left posterior extreme (start of its swing); drive with a phase accumulator
